title: Live-review packet lists prop accounts (account_bounds/accounts) for a package whose prop tickets were SUPPRESSED at entry - implies prop exposure that does not exist
note: MEASURED 2026-11-15 11:43Z (reviewer 0920): ETH pkg-858c60dc674d418f (ml_entry long) listed tradeify_1 and velotrade_1 in its accounts and account_bounds. Both prop tickets were status suppressed (opposite_direction_blocked, opposite_open_position short 0.12 on leg trend_donchian_eth_4h) and never opened. Consequence: the manager held a real-money close for ~2h on a prop-leg risk (LTR-APPLY-EXIT2) that did not apply to this package. Fix: the packet's account list excludes suppressed/never-opened tickets, or flags them as suppressed. Done when a package with suppressed prop tickets shows only its live accounts.
